title: GO:0000018: PCA of Conjoint triad
caption: PCA projection of all 1500 proteins in the GO:0000018 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.06. The first two components explain 12.5% and 3.6% of variance. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
